newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Cyprus president ill with bronchitis.
newsitem.headline: Cyprus president ill with bronchitis.

text.p: Cypriot President Glafcos Clerides has cancelled all appointments for the next two days because he has bronchitis, a medical bulletin said on Wednesday.
Clerides, 76, had been ill with a cold and cancelled appearances on Sunday and Monday but went back to work on Tuesday. A bulletin issued after a checkup said he had a feverish bronchial infection.

His departure later on Wednesday for Dublin to attend the European Union summit has been postponed and he will have more tests on Friday. A government spokesman said Clerides might leave for Dublin on Friday if doctors approved. If not, Foreign Minister Alecos Michaelides would represent Cyprus.
